# Rafael Mouallem Rosa

I am a researcher in the Statify team at Inria, in Grenoble, France. My work focuses on Bayesian inference, with applications to statistical learning and econometrics.

My current research centers on the [**Sources of Uncertainty (SoU)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03134) framework, which introduces confidence as an additional dimension of Bayesian inference, enabling the selective probabilistic treatment of different sources of uncertainty within a model. My broader research agenda is to further develop the framework, explore its connections with other approaches to statistical inference, and pursue applications in economics and finance.

Before joining Inria, I completed a Ph.D. in Economics, working on decision theory, and later worked in financial markets as a quantitative portfolio manager. Across these experiences, a common theme has been uncertainty: the axiomatic study of choices under uncertainty, confronting uncertainty in financial markets, and modelling uncertainty in Bayesian statistical learning.
